column1: # Reviewed migration verdicts. Keyed by name and sha256; the gate (task 07) only
# acts on migrations that have no per-user marker.
#   skip     reviewed, the gate writes the marker without running it
#   replace  reviewed, the gate runs package/migrations/<name> instead
#   preseed  shipped with a marker in /etc/skel for that release, so it is never pending
#            on a fresh install; not reviewed individually. If one is ever pending, the
#            gate treats it as unreviewed (held when privileged).

column4: 4.0.6 baseline: /etc/skel ships its marker. Reviewed: installs linux-omarchy, deletes BOOT_ORDER in /etc/default/limine and makes linux-omarchy first; no-op when /var/lib/omarchy/migrations/1789325478 exists (install creates it)
